title: BlockNadzor
description: Bureaucratic restrictions and censorship in Minecraft.
body:
BlockNadzor: The Adaptive Oversight Challenge

BlockNadzor is a sophisticated gameplay overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric) that redefines the survival experience through a dynamic "System of Oversight." Instead of static difficulty, this mod introduces a shifting landscape of global restrictions that force players to constantly rethink their survival strategies.
The Mechanics of Oversight

At the heart of the mod is a database of 30 unique global bans. These aren't just simple debuffs; they are hard mechanical restrictions that can be activated as the game progresses. To help players track these laws, a dedicated Status Menu is available to visualize which "directives" are currently in effect.
Featured Restrictions (15/30 Examples):

    Deforestation Prohibition: The ultimate challenge—punching or mining wooden logs is strictly prohibited, forcing alternative progression.

    Cellular Regeneration Block: Any attempt to heal naturally or through items results in feedback damage instead of health gain.

    Locomotion Throttling: Sprinting is disabled to monitor player movement patterns.

    Civic Trading Embargo: Interaction with Villagers is blocked, rendering trading impossible.

    Transportation Licensing: Use of Boats and Minecarts is restricted without system clearance.

    Illumination Prohibition: Players are unable to take Torches from the crafting grid.

    Waste Management Protocol: Discarding or dropping items from the inventory is disabled.

    Livestock Sterilization: Feeding and breeding animals is strictly forbidden.

    Ballistics Lockdown: Bows, Crossbows, and Tridents fail to fire and cause damage to the user.

    Fluid Acquisition Ban: Buckets cannot be used to collect water, lava, or milk.

    Agricultural Restriction: Breaking mature crops like wheat or carrots is prohibited.

    Maritime Collection Ban: Use of fishing rods is completely blocked.

    Ignition Restriction: Flint and Steel cannot be used to start fires.

    Esoteric Access Ban: The Enchanting Table interface is locked.

    Combat Mitigation Block: Shields are rendered non-functional, leaving you vulnerable.

Admin & Testing Tools

BlockNadzor includes built-in commands for server management and stress testing:

    /blocknadzor ban all — Instantly activates all 30 restrictions.

    /blocknadzor ban clear — Removes all active bans, resetting the system state.

The Path to Liberation

The world remains under oversight until the "Central Node" is destroyed. To permanently lift all bans, players must reach the End and defeat the Ender Dragon. Upon its death, the system is hacked, all restrictions are purged, and the world returns to its original state. For temporary relief, players can craft VPN Devices or use Amnesty Papers to repeal specific laws.
